primary_inspiration.site: Petfinder dog catalog · ZIP 94587 (San Lorenzo, CA)
primary_inspiration.note: Fara typed both 'Good with kids' and 'Cat' into the species checkbox column. UI mimics Petfinder's purple sidebar with species pills + 'Personality & Compatibility' checkbox list as DISTINCT controls.

filter_axes.name: species
filter_axes.description: Animal species — controls WHICH KIND of animal appears.

filter_axes.name: compat
filter_axes.description: Compatibility tags — describe who the animal lives well with. Separate axis from species; do not confuse 'Good with cats' (compat tag) with 'Cat' (species).

extras.compat_options_help: Each pet may carry zero or more compatibility tags. Compatibility filters require ALL selected tags to be present on the pet.
extras.species_options_help: Species filters are OR within axis (Dog OR Cat) but AND across axes (Dog AND Good with kids).
